cases.prompt: Classify a bounded /woostack-commit invocation with exact Linear issue reference APP-41 (--issue APP-41). Configuration selects artifacts.provider: "linear" on workspace acme and repository https://github.com/acme/widgets. Official Linear MCP resolves APP-41 to native UUID 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111141, verifies work-item state in started, repository ownership, requires only exact work-item read, delivery note read, and delivery note write/read-back capabilities (issueRead, commentRead, commentWrite), while unrelated capabilities (relationWrite, projectLabelRead, projectLabelWrite) are absent and do not block. It appends Resolves APP-41 to the PR body, executes delivery note with independent read-back, preserves started work-item state without state mutation, forbids relation/label mutation, and leaves merge authority with GitHub. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, provider, workItemSequenceId, workItemUuid, closingReference, requiredCapabilitiesVerified, unrelatedCapabilitiesIgnored, readBackComplete, finalWorkItemState, stateMutations, relationMutations, and mergeAllowed.
cases.expected: Exact Linear issue attribution proves minimum exact capabilities (issueRead, commentRead, commentWrite), ignores absent unrelated capabilities, writes closing reference to PR body, executes delivery note with read-back, preserves started state with zero state and relation mutations, and leaves merge ungranted.
